description: How the engine writes a row's numbers in the text the model reads (contract/socket.md, 'How the engine writes a row's numbers for the model'). A number means its value, never the way it was written. Each case lists rows as the exact JSON text a client sent (a string, so the way each number was written is kept: 189 and 189.0 differ here as they do on the wire), the prompt layout and the answer codes; every one of those rows must give exactly 'text', the text of the model's user message (jeff_runtime.engine.model.decision_messages), and so the same answer. The texts were written from the rule, not recorded from the engine.
